name: Criminal Memory
source:
In a rain-soaked city, vampire adventurer Larc saves a girl. He has never seen her before, yet she looks exactly like "her", the cherished light lost long ago. The ghosts of the past have revived forgotten dreams of blood. Who killed Ciel? What exactly happened that night? And nightmare begins anew...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-november-2003-kurenai.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
在一座被雨水浸透的城市里，吸血鬼冒险者拉尔克救下了一名少女。他从未见过她，可她却与“她”长得一模一样——那个早已失去、曾被他珍视为生命之光的人。过去的幽影唤醒了早已遗忘的血色梦境。是谁杀了希耶尔？那一夜究竟发生了什么？噩梦再度开始……

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-november-2003-kurenai.html]vndbreview[/url]]
